implementation.summary: Admitted the bounded source-backed nested-network profile through SORTENTSTABLE's separately validated dictionary route. Validate the nested dictionary, child network ownership, root network action target, reciprocal NOD root, and output table identity before graph traversal; preserve the existing SORTENTSTABLE-only route when no associative records are present.

proof.failureRetry: The selector replaces the root action target with a missing handle, checks complete-export refusal and destination sentinel preservation, restores the target, and verifies successful same-adapter retry and readback for ASCII and binary DXF.

The trace contains 19 VISUALSTYLE parse callbacks. It reports typed=129, typedAndOpaque=228, opaqueFramesRetainedForCorrelation=0; strict complete-export admission remains closed.

physicalPartialDiagnostic.result: EXPECTED REFUSAL at VISUALSTYLE carrier coverage after nested SORTENTSTABLE network closure; no completeness claim

limits: This is a locally generated output and readback proof for one nested-network/SORTENTSTABLE profile, not a physical-source semantic proof.
The physical mechanical DWG still stops at VISUALSTYLE carrier coverage; the 228 opaque callbacks do not have retained frames for correlation.
Strict complete-export admission, broader associative profile closure, independent consumer acceptance, 3D support, and general DWG/DXF parity remain unqualified.
remainingP4Scope: Map all physical callback identities to required fields and roles, provide closure for each required graph profile, and pass strict complete-export admission without weakening refusal.
nextAction: Resolve the physical AC1024 VISUALSTYLE carrier coverage gate by tracing the 19 source callbacks against typed output fields and style-reference closure; admit only a fully source-bound serializer route and generated exact-readback proof.
